name: openclaw
_comment: VERIFIED end-to-end 2026-07-08 against OpenClaw 2026.3.11 (macOS) via scripts/verify_harness.py — the woken agent read the briefing and echoed the canary token. Flags re-checked 2026-08-28 against current docs (2026.7.1-2 era): all still valid; not re-run end-to-end since. The explicit --session-id is required: without a session selector `openclaw agent` exits 1. On an install with MORE than one configured agent you must also pass --agent <id> (single-agent installs resolve implicitly) — but know open openclaw issue #60609: passing --agent causes --session-id to be ignored (routes to the agent's main session). Every wake reuses the one zugamind-wake session; rotate the id if accumulated session state ever becomes a problem. --timeout 180 under timeout_sec 240 is deliberate layering: the CLI times out and exits cleanly (full output, real returncode) before the engine's hard kill at 240s, which only salvages partial output and drops the returncode; either way the engine journals at most 2000 chars of stdout/stderr, so do not assume a full --json payload survives into journal.jsonl. Set wake_modules/wake_min_salience before running unattended (see examples/harness-configs/README.md). Ships enabled:false so copying the file is never enough to spend money by accident.
command: You were woken by ZugaMind, a cognition sidecar. Read the file at {briefing_file} and act on what it asks.
